question: The 2025 SEA Games were scheduled to be held in which country
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Thailand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **2025 SEA Games** are scheduled to be hosted by **Thailand**.
 
• The **SEA Games** (Southeast Asian Games) is a biennial multi-sport event involving participants from the **11 countries** of Southeast Asia.
 
• Thailand has a rich history of hosting sports events and has previously hosted multiple editions of the **SEA Games**.
